# Third-party assets

Logos and marks owned by other companies, kept here so the directory itself makes
the ownership obvious. **Nothing in this folder is a Buttery asset.** Buttery's own
marks live at the root of `public/`.

Use these only to identify the service they belong to (e.g. an "Import from
Paprika 3" button). Don't restyle, recolour, or compose them into Buttery brand
artwork.

| Path                       | Owner                                       | Source                            |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `paprika/paprika-icon.png` | Hindsight Labs LLC (Paprika Recipe Manager) | Google Play listing icon, 256×256 |
